summary: Read-first customer setup route recovery ran in real Business Central UI. No setup page was accepted: direct page-id routes fell back to Role Center, broad Tell-Me/search stayed in the search overlay or opened an unrelated Power BI setup dialog. The run is useful blocker evidence and keeps the customer setup write gate closed.

notProved: No customer setup value was selected or written.

screenshotQa.reason: Accepted as blocker evidence, rejected as setup-page proof: screenshots show Role Center fallback, Tell-Me overlay or an unrelated Power BI setup dialog instead of the requested setup lists.

uiLearning: Direct page-id navigation can fall back to Role Center and broad Tell-Me clicks can open categories or unrelated dialogs. Next route must be a materially different read-only navigation hypothesis with screenshot QA, hover/tooltip where useful, and Page Inspection confirmation.

nextStepDecision.reason: At least one required setup page remains blocked; write gate remains blocked.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: O2C needs setup values plus item/service readiness before a process route.
Only accepted setup pages can feed training text; blocked routes remain an internal note.

nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: Repeating the same write gate would be unsafe while route recovery is incomplete.
risksBeforeNextCase: Visible setup list does not equal correctness.
Do not assign values until a separate Smart Decision names exact codes.
requiredPreparation: Repair remaining blocked route(s) or consciously park them with a safer Foundation alternative.

nextStep: Run a materially different read-first customer setup route recovery: do not repeat broad Tell-Me category clicks; inspect real navigation surfaces such as Alle Berichte/menus/scoped setup lists with screenshot QA and Page Inspection before any customer setup write gate.
